notes.title: Changes and Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]A Few Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased the speed of all vehicles
[*] Can scroll view in and out while in 3rd person view in a vehicle
[*] Can reset a vehicle to the road with [b]ctrl + P[/b]
[*] Can no longer manually equip the shovel
[*] Can go on the small pier
[*] Added a good fishing spot to the pier
[/list]

[b]Fix[/b]

[list]
[*] Steel toe shoes can be paired both left to right and right to left
[*] Crack no longer shows on repaired alien ships
[*] Loose screw is easier to fix on 35kg barbell
[*] Can no longer get stuck in items when buy large items with a full inventory
[*] Fixed issue with work station sometimes leaving storage boxes behind when picked up
[*] Caboose lid, the box for the wagon and the storage for the fisher rice car are all easier to add / remove and open / close
[*] Hoods on all vehicles are easier to open / close
[*] Antique table with a loose screw can now be repaired properly
[*] Cannot pick up the office setup while an outgoing order is waiting to be fulfilled
[*] Office setup requires confirm before picking up
[*] Fixed issue when rarely an item would indicate someone is looking at it when no one is looking at it
[*] Fixed interaction with handing in the teddy bear to the boy by the river and it can no longer be handed in from anywhere, you need to be near the boy
[*] The arrows indicating metal detector and shovel in the inventory no longer stay up until you click them
[/list]

notes.title: Out of This World Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Items[/h1]

[b]New sets of items to honor our friends and thank them for all they do[/b]

[list]
[*] 12 new items in total 
[*] New items can be found at yard sales, the storage auction and low value items in the dumpster
[*] New items can be paired. Find the match to complete the item and get max profit.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The items from The Boys of Summer Update can now also be found at yard sales and low value items in dumpsters
[*] Dumpsters now have an open all button
[*] Searching dumpsters is much faster
[*] Can escape the level up message by pressing any key
[*] Magnet fishing is faster
[*] Cashier at the big business cashes out faster
[*] All employees at every house do all tasks. They will clean and do all repairs now but vary by speed
[*] Change the cost of some employees
[*] Can now hire an employee at the cafe
[/list]

[h1]Fix[/h1]

[list]
[*] Cups and plates can no longer be endlessly puttied
[*] while placing an item (green item is out for placement) u could open inventory, highlight an item and hit enter which would make both the highlighted item and the item being placed to disappear
[*] Picking up an item while trying to price it would cause the pricing menu to stick up with no way to exit
[*] Picking up a counter / table near a vehicle would cause you to enter the vehicle and be stuck in the confirm pick up menu
[*] Fixed screw placement on red lawn mower
[*] Fixed damage on white potted plant
[*] "counter" did not have a confirm pickup option like other tables and counters
[*] When moving out of either business the sale sign would appear floating inside the store instead of on the wall outside the store
[*] Rugs or other thin items like cards would not sell if placed on the floor of either business
[*] Talking to the auctioneer as the auction is ending causes player to be stuck
[*] Fixed the employees speed at the mansion and $200k house
[*] The metal detector no longer continues to beep after digging something up
[*] Decreased the noise of the metal detector
[*] Fixed issue with picking up the storage while using it
[/list]

notes.title: The Boys of Summer Update
notes.notes:
[h1]More Friends to Find[/h1]

Both of us here at Queenfish Games are very grateful for all the people who have taken the time to try our game and our humble community whos overwhelmingly generous support keeps us going. Thank you! 
Today we welcome 3 awesome members of the fish fam into the game as exciting new items to collect. 
[list]
[*] 9 new items to find, clean, repair and sell
[*] New items can only be found at the storage auction
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] The metal detector will always be found at the same location instead of having a chance to be in 1 of 3 locations
[*] The shovel will always be found at the same location instead of having a chance to be in 1 of 3 locations
[*] Can buy more than 1 lockpick at a time
[*] Cannot buy more than 10 lockpicks
[*] Added a confirm or deny option when pressing F9 for quick load
[*] Added a confirm or deny option when picking up a table or shelf
[*] Extended the footprint of the work bench to make cleaning at the work bench slightly easier
[*] Added a warning if you try to repair an item but haven't unlocked the required tool
[/list]

[b]Fix[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some descriptions on items in dumpsters
[*] Mugs and plates were indicating damaged when in inventory when they were in great condition
[/list]

notes.title: Changes
notes.notes:
[b]A few quality of life changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Stamina refills faster
[*] Daily stamina drains slower over time
[*] Removed the option to drag and drop. Inventory can be moved with the R key.
[*] Item quality shows in inventory. (dirty, damaged, etc)
[*] Batteries last longer
[/list]

notes.title: Shirts and Shovels Update
notes.notes:
[b]Shirts[/b]
Shirtsy will now sell you all 5 YouTuber shirts after you have returned all the items he wants.

[b]Shovels[/b]
The shovel will now be used automatically when digging up metal detecting mounds. All you have to do is find it!

notes.title: Estates Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Buy A House[/h1]
[b]You've worked hard to build your yard sale empire, now enjoy all your polished treasures in style in your brand new house![/b]
[list]
[*] 3 properties to purchase.
[*] Purchase the cafe to open up new housing opportunities.
[*] Bought houses provide the same benefits as rented houses without the bills and also attract more customers to your yard sale.
[*] All bought houses can be resold at the house sign.
[*] No level requirements. You just need the cash.
[/list]

[h1]Explore A New Area[/h1]
[b]The people of Yuppie Estates are very particular on who they let in. Show them you are a reputable business person by purchasing the business by the entrance to Yuppie Estates. They are sick and tired of looking at the trash left behind and would gladly welcome anyone willing to take on this challenge. [/b]
[list]
[*] 3 new yard sales to shop.
[*] New garbage cans to rummage.
[*] Houses to buy.
[*] 3 new fast and cheap employees to hire.
[/list]

[h1]More Yard Sale Treasure[/h1]
[b]37 new items to find at yard sales, in dumpsters, metal detecting, magnet fishing, in your new cafe and by helping out a new friend.[/b]

[h1]Collect Your Favorite YouTuber Shirt[/h1]
[b]Explore Yuppie Estates to find Shirtsy hard at work in his garage. Shirtsy has some one of a kind merch he is willing to part with for the right items. [/b]

[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]
2 new achievements to obtain.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved customer flow at the big house that can be rented.
[*] Less customers shop from the 2 yard sales surrounding the big rented house making for more high quality items available.
[*] Yard sale customers intially show up quicker at all houses.
[/list]

notes.title: Improvements and bug fix
notes.notes:
[b]Storage Auction Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Storage auctions can now be started anytime after 13:00
[*] Interact with the sign to start the days auctions
[*] Talk to the auctioneer when you are ready to start bidding
[*] increased odds of multiple auctions per day
[/list]

[b]Clear Dropped Items[/b]
Added a 'Clear Dropped Items' button to the pause menu that will clear any items that have been dragged and dropped out of your inventory or any items left behind from dumpsters, dig spots, cabins, storage auctions or magnet fishing.

[b]Trailers[/b]
Changed the way trailers attach to vehicles. Making it easier to interact to connect the trailer and easier to connect straight behind the vehicle. Changed the way they handle to make for a more enjoyable driving experience.

[b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with taking items out of storage when inventory is full.
[*] Fixed issue with moving items when outside of property line or workbench area causing the item to disapear.
[/list]

notes.title: Storage Auction Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Storage Auctions[/h1]
[b]Save your cash and test your luck at the Sunshine Storage Unit auction today![/b]
[list]
[*] Storage auctions happen daily at 14:00
[*] The first auction will start when all NPC participants have arrived.
[*] Minimum of one auction will be held daily. There is a chance for two auctions and a rare chance for three auctions.
[*] Talk to the auctioneer to take place in bidding.
[*] Gain trade experience on every win.
[*] Chance to find rare items only available from storage units.
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[b]Three new Steam achievements to unlock[/b]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] Nine new yard sale items.
[*] Three new Flippin' Marketplace orders to fulfill.
[*] One new item to buy on the Flippin' Marketplace
[/list]

[h1]Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added "Quick Move" to the controls menu. Press R to quickly move highlighted item between inventory / storage.
[*] "Retro Fun" order on the Flippin' Marketplace now accepts the Funtendo console and can therefor be completed.
[*] Market stall vendors now have items out for sale all day with the exception of selling out.
[*] Fixed issue with yard sale vendors having some items that were already bought out for sale on reload.
[*] Fixed boundary indicator on the small business.
[/list]

notes.title: Dirty Work Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Employees[/h1]
[b]Head down to the tool shop to pick up your new work station and get started on your way to be a boss!
[/b]
[list]
[*] Work stations can be placed on any property you rent.
[*] Access dailyhire.io from your work station to hire employees.
[*] Each location draws in different potential employees.
[*] Hire 1 employee per work station.
[*] Each employee has different abilities and work speed.
[*] Employees must have the appropriate tools nearby. An air compressor for cleaning,  a putty pale and detail paint for repair.
[/list]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[b]Decorate your walls![/b]
[list]
[*] 9 new items to be found, bought, cleaned, repaired and sold at your yard sale.
[*] All new items can be hung on your walls.
[*] 3 new corresponding Flippin' Marketplace orders to fulfill.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Move items around your property with ease. Move an item without the need to go in your inventory by pressing Shift when picking up. 
[*] Tools will stay in your hand until dropped. Making cleaning and repair a smoother process.
[*] Added an option to move out of a rented property. Can be accessed by mail when rent is due.
[*] Added a lockpick holder to the inventory screen. Holds 10 lockpicks at a time, making for more free space in your inventory.
[/list]

[b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed color issue on stuffed animals when cleaning.
[*] Sword no longer turns into naval sword.
[/list]

notes.title: Community Update
notes.notes:
[b]Thank You[/b]
Yard Sale Simulator provides alot of freedom in playstyle and we love to see all the different ways people enjoy the yard sale life. One surprise was the personality and names people have given to the towns people over time. Thanks to the suggestions of our friends on Discord we would like introduce some of these personalities into the game today and with more to come in the future.

[b]New Items[/b]
6 new items added

[b]Flippin' Marketplace[/b]
16 new orders to fulfill on the marketplace

[b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with tooltip not showing on most items prior to completing the tutorial
[*] Changed the tutorial to more clearly indicate the need to right click items in inventory to place the item
[/list]

notes.title: Opening Doors Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Lockpicking[/h1]
[b]Get the most out of yard sales now with even more ways to find treasure! Finally see what's behind those brown doors![/b]
[list]
[*] Locked cabin doors can be opened with a lockpick and a toolbelt with a screwdriver.
[*] Lockpicks can be purchased from the tool shop counter.
[*] Locked cabins hold 1 - 7 items of varying levels in mostly poor condition.
[*] Locked cabins will reset every 1-4 days.
[/list]

[h1]New Grab Box[/h1]
Even more fun to find with 2 more grab boxes! New boxes are themed safes with lots of new loot to find. Get out to those yard sales early before it's too late and see what you will find today.

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] 39 new yard sale items to find, fix and sell ... or hoard.
[*] A new collectable friendly YouTuber!
[*] All new items can be bought at yard sales.
[*] Some can be found in dumpsters and in the locked cabins.
[/list]

[h1]Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Can exit the level up screen with esc or tab.
[*] Small business wall color now sets correctly.
[*] Can only place items inside property boundry.
[*] Removed level requirement to purchase a battery.
[*] Fixed display name for Funtendo.
[*] Can buy more than 1 of each item at Top Shelf.
[*] Added signs to both gas stations.
[/list]

notes.title: Flippin' Marketplace Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Flippin' Marketplace[/h1]
[b]New online marketplace for buying and selling![/b]

Home Office
[list]
[*] Home office available to purchase at the post office.
[*] The post office unlocks at level 7 trade.
[*] Can be placed and used on any rented property.
[*] Use to access The Flippin' Marketplace.
[/list]

Online Market
[list]
[*] Bid on high quality items in an active auction.
[*] Winning auctions will be delivered right to your front door the following morning.
[*] Fulfill orders for customers online.
[*] Fulfilling orders increases your seller rank, unlocking more options.
[/list]

[h1]Lootboxes[/h1]
[b]Some people have too much stuff to even bother going through so they have thrown it all in a box to make a quick buck or dispose of quickly. Test your luck today and see if you can find yourself a box of treasures.[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 types of boxes can be purchased from yard sales.
[*] 1 type can be found in dumpsters.
[*] 1 type can be magnet fished out of the water.
[*] Take them home to open up and see what you have found!
[/list]

[h1]Many New Items[/h1]
[b]Toy Train[/b]
[list]
[*] New battery powered kids vehicle.
[*] The train has an attachable caboose.
[*] The caboose has an attachable lid with storage.
[*] Can be obtained from a lootbox.
[*] Can be sold to Fast Freddy.
[*] Can only be obtained once per game.
[/list]

[b]Shoes[/b]
[list]
[*] Pairs of shoes can be bought at yard sales.
[*] Single shoes can be found in dumpsters.
[*] Single steel toe shoes can be magnet fished out of the water.
[*] Cleaned and repaired shoes can be put together and sold for more as a pair.
[*] To pair, place one shoe and click the matching shoe in your inventory while looking at the placed shoe. (The same process as replcing a battery.) 
[/list]

[b]2 New YouTubers To Collect[/b]
and much more including comic books and more games.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Customers are less likely to buy over priced items. Odds increase at level 4 trade and again at level 8 trade.
[*] Customers have a greater chance to decline the purchase when you counter offer a higher price.
[*] Rent has increased 2x.
[*] Customers return quicker to the big house and both businesses
[/list]

[b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue with vehicles not driving sometimes.
[*] Lighting improvements.
[*] Fixed issue with a successful magnet fish not returning an item.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Changed the location to the trailer park
[*] Added magnet fishing
[*] Many new items added
[*] Time of day added
[*] Removed cap on items that can be found with the metal detector (resets each day)
[*] Current saves on the old demo will be reset to start a fresh game on the new demo
[/list]

notes.title: Fish 'n' Friends Update
notes.notes:
[h1]A New Way To Find Items[/h1]

[b]Magnet Fishing Kit[/b]
Grab your metal detector and head on down to the water to get started on your fishing adventure! 
While you are there have a look around for someone in need. They may be able to help you get started.

[b]Find More Valuable Items[/b]
Attach more powerful magnets to up your scavenger game! Magnets can be found in the sand and water or bought from the tool store. Increase your odds of pulling in that precious junk and even find rare items in the right location. Try your luck anywhere in the water but you will have better luck in certain spots.

[h1]New Items[/h1]

27 new items to be bought and found including 2 rare items made in likeness of 2 YouTube personalities you may recognize.

[h1]Fix[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed vehicles continuous acceleration
[*] Fix for using Tab to close inventory
[/list]

notes.title: Handyman Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Toolbelt[/h1]
Those skilled in repair can head on down to the Tool Shop and pick up a spiffy new belt. Load your belt up with portable tools to free up some precious inventory space and easily access your tools.

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
Now you can yard sale with your controller or Steam Deck!

[h1]Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the odds of finding something in dumpsters
[*] Smoothed out backup cam on vehicles
[*] Fix for interacting with cards on boxes at some yard sales
[*] Fix for cards disappearing when placed on some floors
[*] Reset Bruh! achievment
[*] Trailers will load in facing upright
[/list]

notes.title: Furniture Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Many New Items[/h1]
Find or buy 70 new items to bring home and fix up. Resell your new items or keep them to spruce up your home.

[h1]New Stores[/h1]
Looking for a certain item to finish off that decor? Head downtown to the furniture or appliance store.
The new stores only sell good quality items at a high mark up. Poor quality and high quality items can be found around town.

[h1]New Vehicles[/h1]
2 new kids vehicles can be found around town.
[b]Custom Flower Wheels[/b]
[list]
[*] Can only be obtained one time per game.
[*] Must complete required task for the owner to sell to you.
[/list]
[b]Other Vehicle[/b]
A rare item that can be obtained multiple times.

[h1]Back up Cam[/h1]
Hitch those trailers with more ease.
The camera will switch on reverse.

[h1]Economy[/h1]
[list]
[*] Customers are less likely to buy over priced items.
[*] Cannot counter offer higher than the original asking price when a customer low balls you.
[*] Decreased chances of finding high quality items.
[*] Items that are not yet on display at yard sales and markets come at an initial 10% discount. (down from 15%) 
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Lamps and fireplaces can be turned on and off when fully cleaned and repaired.
[*] Customers are less likely to buy an item if they are not close to the item.
[/list]

[b]What We Are Working On[/b]
Thank you to everyone for playing and an extra thanks to all the people who took the time to provide feedback and reviews. We are working hard on the next update we hope you will enjoy.
[list]
[*] A whole new fun way to find good and high quality items.
[*] Expanding upon dumpster diving to make it more relevant in later game.
[*] Easier access to portable tools.
[*] More vehicles.
[*] ... and always more items to clean and fix
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fix for customers buying items not set for sale.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[b]Load Game[/b]
Added a load game button to the pause menu.

[b]Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with getting stuck in the haggle screeen when time hits 13:00
[i]Note: At the market you will get kicked out of the haggle screen even tho the market stays open[/i]
[*] Customers will not try to buy items that are not set for sale such as tables used for display.
[*] Fixed issue that could casuse trailers to be lost on load.
[*] Fixed issue causing items bought from yard sales or market to sometimes be lost.
[*] Changed the price of some items at yard sales and the market.
[*] Changed the rate at which some items spawn at the market.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with confirm button not responding on tutorial if reload during tutorial.
[*] Fixed texture on some items (more to come).
[*] Fixed issue with items rarely "being looked at" when no customers are looking at that item.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]Day 1 Fixes[/h1]
[b]After a wonderful day one we bring you these fixes. Thanks for the reports and thanks for playing![/b]
[list]
[*] Fast Freddy has all cars for display but not available for purchase until the required level is reached. Fixing the issue of not being able to purchase after reaching the required level and eliminating floating car :)
[*] Customers will not purchase an item if you are inspecting it. Hopefully solving the issue some were having getting stuck inspecting.
[*] The $1 coin now adds $1.00 to your money instead of going in your inventory and then having to click it to recieve $1.00.
[*] Can no longer add more than one box to your wagon.
[*] Fixed issue with falling asleep at sunset or because of lack of daily stamina while inspecting, buying, selling or dumpster diving.
[*] Fixed tooltip for tables and shelves.
[*] Fixed issue with picking up cards on certain tables
[/list]
